sentences.text: The Court made the following Order:-

This Criminal Petition under Section 482 of B.N.S.S., is filed by the petitioner herein seeking to grant anticipatory bail in Crime No.
23 of 2024 of Madhavaram Police Station, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 408, 477-A and 420 IPC and Section 156(3) Cr.P.C.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there is a delay of two years in lodging the report against the petitioner, whereas the petitioner had already tendered his resignation three years prior to the filing of the complaint.
This complaint was lodged unnecessarily, for the best reasons best known to the defacto complainant.

3. On the other hand, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that the offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable with imprisonment of less than seven years and undertakes to issue notice under Section 35(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
 2  4. Heard. Perused the material on record.
 5.
 Since the offences alleged are punishable with imprisonment of  seven years, this Court directs the police to follow the procedure as  contemplated under Section 35(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Deepak Kumar, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171937882/
2  Sanhita, 2023, scrupulously, as per the guidelines enunciated in  Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and another^ The petitioner shall  comply with the conditions, without any default.
 6.
